mapper.select: /* CastChknMapper.retrieveCknctCntList */ SELECT SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS ISLAND, COUNT(A.CKNCT_ID) AS CKNCT_CNT FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_CKNCT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.CKNCT_USE_CRG_APLCN_TYPE_CD IN (#{item}) GROUP BY SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) ORDER BY ISLAND

/* CastChknMapper.retrieveChknList */ SELECT Y.ISLAND, Y.COUNTER_NUM, Y.ALN_CD, Y.START_HOUR AS "START",
CASE WHEN Y.END_HOUR <= Y.START_HOUR THEN 24 ELSE Y.END_HOUR END AS "END" FROM ( SELECT SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 0, 1) AS ISLAND, TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 2, 2)) AS COUNTER_NUM, A.ALN_CD, TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(NVL(A.EST_BGNG_HM, A.LAST_BGNG_HM), 1, 2)) AS START_HOUR, CEIL(TO_NUMBER(NVL(A.EST_END_HM, A.LAST_END_HM)) / 100) AS END_HOUR FROM GOOWN.TI_GO_CKNCT_DALY_ALOT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.OPER_YMD = #{ymd} AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND REGEXP_LIKE(SUBSTR(A.CKNCT_ID, 2, 2), '^[0-9]+$') AND NVL(A.EST_BGNG_HM, A.LAST_BGNG_HM) IS NOT NULL AND NVL(A.EST_END_HM, A.LAST_END_HM) IS NOT NULL AND NVL(A.EST_BGNG_HM, A.LAST_BGNG_HM) != NVL(A.EST_END_HM, A.LAST_END_HM) ) Y ORDER BY Y.ISLAND, Y.COUNTER_NUM, Y.ALN_CD
